mechanism: Darunavir inhibits CYP3A4, which may reduce CoQ10 metabolism and increase systemic levels; additionally, protease inhibitors are known to deplete CoQ10 stores, potentially counteracting supplementation benefits.
action: Monitor for myopathy symptoms; consider CoQ10 supplementation beneficial in this population as protease inhibitors deplete endogenous CoQ10; dose adjustment of CoQ10 may be needed based on clinical response.
